title: AI POD subsystem 06 - UCS workload nodes
description: Canonical composed inventory contract for UCS systems assigned to the workload tier. A domain is represented by its two CIMC endpoints but becomes one Intersight claim target; that cross-system relationship is validated by the inventory adapter. Model, serial number, product family, installed GPUs, Device ID, and Claim Code are discovered at runtime and never manually duplicated here.

inventory_host.description: Stable Ansible inventory handle. It is generated by the adapter from inventory.yml, not copied as a second editable value into host_vars.

platform.description: UCS workload platform. domain represents a paired UCS-X Direct or UCS domain; standalone represents one rack server.

role.description: Hardware workload capability. Subsystem 07 later determines the OpenShift worker or compact role.

intersight_claim_supported.description: Set false for UCS C880, which does not support Intersight claim or reclaim. Excluded standalone nodes must omit claim_target; supported systems still require it. This is an onboarding capability, not a discovered hardware model.

claim_target.description: Stable target key used to deduplicate a paired domain into one Intersight claim. Supported standalone systems use their own inventory handle. Omit for nodes with intersight_claim_supported: false.
